Road-trip deals

  • Diwali road trips — Take the long weekend on the road: lights in Jaipur and Udaipur, quiet Goa beaches, or the Kerala hills.
  • Winter in Rajasthan — Cool, clear days from November to February: forts, stepwells and desert camps under the stars.
  • Summer in the Himalaya — The high roads to Ladakh and Spiti open from June: lakes, monasteries and passes above 5,000 m.
  • Monsoon magic in Kerala & Coorg — Green, misty and quiet — waterfalls at full flow, and lower prices on many vans.
